list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Refactor sign-up role selection and update app branding to StockFlow
- Replace the legacy `Spinner` with a Material `ExposedDropdownMenu` (`AutoCompleteTextView`) for role selection in `SignUpActivity` - Update app branding references from "SpazaStock" to "StockFlow" across string resources and layouts - Integrate a `SystemBars` utility to handle status and navigation bar styling across all major activities - Configure `navigationBarColor` and `windowLightNavigationBar` in `themes.xml` for consistent system UI appearance - Adjust header padding in `activity_login.xml` and `activity_signup.xml` for better visual balance - Implement `onItemClickListener` in `SignUpActivity` to manage role selection state from the new dropdown - Update the IDE workspace configuration to reflect recent project changes and resource updates

task.summary:
Implement login screen and authentication logic
- Create `LoginActivity` and `LoginViewModel` using ViewBinding - Implement `AuthRepository` with mock authentication functionality - Design login layout using Material Components and brand-specific styling - Configure `LoginActivity` as the entry point in `AndroidManifest.xml` - Add supporting vector assets, colors, and string resources - Update project dependencies and adjust target SDK to 35

Implement login screen and authentication logic
- Create `LoginActivity` and `LoginViewModel` using ViewBinding - Implement `AuthRepository` with mock authentication functionality - Design login layout using Material Components and brand-specific styling - Configure `LoginActivity` as the entry point in `AndroidManifest.xml` - Add supporting vector assets, colors, and string resources - Update project dependencies and adjust target SDK to 35

Implement login screen and authentication logic
- Create `LoginActivity` and `LoginViewModel` using ViewBinding - Implement `AuthRepository` with mock authentication functionality - Design login layout using Material Components and brand-specific styling - Configure `LoginActivity` as the entry point in `AndroidManifest.xml` - Add supporting vector assets, colors, and string resources - Update project dependencies and adjust target SDK to 35

Implement sign-up screen and registration logic
- Create `SignUpActivity` and `SignUpViewModel` to handle user registration - Implement mock `signUp` functionality in `AuthRepository` with field validation - Design registration layout using `CoordinatorLayout` and `MaterialCardView` - Add collapsing header animations and password visibility toggles - Update `LoginActivity` to navigate to the sign-up screen - Add required vector assets and string resources for the registration flow

Update CI workflow trigger branches to master
- Change target branch from `main` to `master` for push and pull request events in `ci.yml`

Implement dashboard screen and navigation logic
- Create `DashboardActivity` and `DashboardViewModel` using ViewBinding - Design a comprehensive dashboard layout featuring statistics cards, quick actions, and recent sales - Implement bottom navigation using `BottomNavigationView` with a dedicated menu resource - Update `LoginActivity` to navigate to the dashboard upon successful authentication - Add supporting vector assets, custom shape drawables for UI cards, and string resources - Register `DashboardActivity` in the `AndroidManifest.xml`

Refactor app architecture to use Fragments with Bottom Navigation
- Convert `MainActivity` to `AppCompatActivity` and implement a `BottomNavigationView` for primary navigation - Create `DashboardFragment`, `InventoryFragment`, `SalesFragment`, and `SuppliersFragment` to handle core app sections - Implement navigation from the dashboard to new activities: `LowStockActivity`, `ReportsActivity`, and `AddProductActivity` - Add `PurchaseOrderActivity` and corresponding layout to the suppliers flow - Update `LoginActivity` to navigate to `MainActivity` upon successful authentication - Design comprehensive XML layouts for all fragments and activities using `ConstraintLayout`, `MaterialCardView`, and `NestedScrollView` - Integrate `androidx.fragment.ktx` dependency and update `AndroidManifest.xml` with new activity entries - Remove the legacy `DashboardActivity` in favor of fragment-based architecture

feat(backend): initialize Ktor API with PostgreSQL and Exposed ORM • Set up a clean architecture with separate models, repositories, and services. • Configured HikariCP connection pooling and Exposed for type-safe database access. • Implemented centralized error handling via StatusPages and JSON serialization. • Added and verified GET /api/health endpoint for service monitoring.

feat(backend): initialize Ktor API with PostgreSQL and Exposed ORM • Set up a clean architecture with separate models, repositories, and services. • Configured HikariCP connection pooling and Exposed for type-safe database access. • Implemented centralized error handling via StatusPages and JSON serialization. • Added and verified GET /api/health endpoint for service monitoring.

feat(auth): implement JWT authentication and restructure project layout
• Restructured the repository into a monorepo format with dedicated `app/` and `backend/` directories. • Integrated JWT-based authentication in the Ktor backend using `ktor-server-auth-jwt`. • Implemented a `POST /login` endpoint supporting authentication via both username and email. • Added JWT token generation logic, validation middleware, and security configuration. • Updated `UserRepository` and `UserService` to facilitate user lookup by identifier and secure password verification via BCrypt. • Enhanced centralized error handling in `StatusPages` to include `UnauthorizedException`. • Added a root-level `README.md` and a `.env.example` for backend configuration.

feat(auth): implement JWT authentication and restructure project layout

Added app logo by replacing all logo place holders

Update project dependencies, JDK configuration, and Google Auth logic
- Upgrade Kotlin version to `2.2.10` in the top-level `build.gradle.kts` - Update Gradle properties to use local JDK 21 and disable automatic toolchain downloads - Refactor `GoogleAuthClient.kt` to use `GetGoogleIdOption` directly within `GetCredentialRequest` and remove the redundant `requestToken` helper method - Update `google_web_client_id` with a valid client ID in `strings.xml` - Cleanup unused dependencies (`androidx.core.ktx` and `androidx.lifecycle.runtime.ktx`) in `app/build.gradle.kts` - Update IDE configuration in `.idea/workspace.xml` to include new drawable resources and reflect recent project changes - Remove deprecated toolchain download URLs from `gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties`
